context: Mei and Ren reminisce about a train journey.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (中古/高級/修理/列車/出会っ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 去年の列車旅、楽しかったね。
lines.en: Last year's train trip was fun.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle nostalgic delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、古い列車に乗れて良かったね。
lines.en: Yeah, glad we rode the old train.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm reflective delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 車内で、地元の方に出会ったよね。
lines.en: We met a local on board.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 高級な弁当も、おいしかったな。
lines.en: The premium bento was delicious too.
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 中古の駅舎も、味があったね。
lines.en: The old station building had character too.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 修理されながら、残ってるのが素敵だね。
lines.en: It's lovely that it remains, repaired over time.
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: また、列車で旅したいな。
lines.en: I want to travel by train again.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新しい出会いも、あるだろうね。
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
